sources.title: Minimax-H3-fl2va-ref2va-hybrid-models: Text-to-Video model — overview ...
sources.snippet: Overview Minimax-H3-fl2va-ref2va-hybrid-models is a merged variant of MiniMax H3, a joint audio+video diffusion transformer that combines two officially released checkpoints— fl2va and ref2va —into a single model. Created by smhfacct, this model solves a fundamental tradeoff in the original H3 checkpoints: fl2va produces higher visual and audio quality but lacks reference conditioning ...
